title: Otori Emu — Smiling Fairy〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Nonogi Park
se_walk_men_001_4

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, this looks like a fine spot.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There aren't many people around, either. It should be perfect for practice.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. Let's work hard, with our sights set on winning the contest!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu messaged saying she was almost here, so she should be—

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Heeeey!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, what perfect timing.
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, is it just me, or does Emu have wings on her back...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see them too, so it's not just you, no.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: She's arrived with her costume already on! Such motivation!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here I aaam! Sorry for the wait!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Good morning, Emu. So... Why did you arrive with your wings on?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, you mean these wings?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm playing the fairy in our next show, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I figured, if I wore my wings around, I'd get lots of ideas about how she would move and how to act that out!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I guess I can sort of see that, but people must have been staring...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The mysterious winged girl... Emu might have given rise to a brand-new urban legend.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A legend?! I'm gonna be legendary?! Hooray!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's not really something to be pleased about.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hah hah hah! I think it's wonderful to think about your role that deeply.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: After all, you'll be playing a lady-in-waiting and other small roles as well, but the fairy is your main role!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's an excellent idea to think about your role and put every last drop of energy into your performance! Just be careful not to damage or wear out your wings.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okaaay!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, if it helps you work things out, I think it's fine. The fairy's an important character for the princess and prince's journey, after all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right. She also serves as comic relief, so I hope you'll give her your all.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. I want to show everyone how funny the fairy you wrote for me is!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And if I want to make her really, really fun and interesting, I need...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Physical acting, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! That's why I'm thinking so hard about it!

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line: Huh? Look, Nana! That girl has wings!

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Oh... She does...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Those munchkins are looking at us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, it's hard to ignore a girl with fairy wings on.
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line: Hi, Miss. What are you doing?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're practicing for a show! I'm playing a fairy!

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: A fairy...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “You called, and here I am! I'm your oh-so-cute fairy friend!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Here we go! Pose!”

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: That's a weird fairy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “Huh?! A weird fairy?! Where? Where is she?”

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line: Hahaha, it's you! The fairies in storybooks are quiet and graceful.

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: And they don't move weird like that either.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Wha-huh?! I'm the weird fairy?!
No way, no way! Look how graceful I am!”

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Hehe, “wha-huh”.

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line: That's weird!

rows.Speaker: Girl A
rows.Line: Good luck with your show!

rows.Speaker: Girl B
rows.Line: Bye bye, Ms. Weird Fairy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks! See you!
se_walk_women_001_3
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, that was fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, wait! I was supposed to be practicing my fairy moves!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I need to decide how I'm gonna move for our scenes today!
Hmmmm...!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wouldn't what you just did be fine?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
The way you moved while talking to those kids.
They really liked all the fun ways you reacted to them.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I think it would make a fine base to work from.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ooh, okay! In that case, um...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I... What did I do, again?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You did it yourself, just a moment ago!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know, but I was so focused on making those kids smile, like whoosh! Kapow! And now I don't remember any of it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're unbelievable...
Remember when you said, “Wha-huh!” and all that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, right! I remember!
What else did I do?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Why do I have to teach you how to do what you just did...?
Alright, watch closely now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks!
